place: a flat city rooftop at night
situation_hero: you just woke up lying on a city rooftop at night; you do not know how you got here; the roof door bangs open and someone runs out toward you

actors.name: Dan
actors.look: a breathless young man in a rain-soaked hoodie, worried eyes
actors.persona: Dan: he says he is the hero's old friend. He just ran up eleven floors because he is sure the hero is about to jump, and he will do anything to get him away from the edge. He is scared, talks too fast, and is hiding why he really came tonight.
